title: The mall world video game concept
content: First off I’ve never made a video game but I am going to try with the unreal engine. I want to make one about mall world and am asking if anyone would be willing to send some pictures to use as inspiration concept. A map maybe would be great and some photos you drew or ai generated so I can get a general idea. I myself have only visited very few locations and want to make it accurate as possible. Anyone interested or is this a dumb idea?
